summary: The code is syntactically valid and imports resolve, but it lacks a runnable simulation: main() is a no-op, agents are never instantiated, there is no simulation loop, interactions, metrics, or validation criteria. Several entities and attributes deviate from the specification, and key behaviors (supply purchase, policy effects, norm observation) are not integrated. There is also a potential performance issue in the small-world network generator. The direct main() call is present as required.

issues.description: No runnable simulation: main() is a placeholder and there is no simulation loop. No agents are created, no steps are executed, and no outputs are produced.
issues.location: main(); Simulation.__init__ (no run/step methods or invocation)
issues.solution: Implement a main() that parses parameters, constructs the Simulation, instantiates agents (persons, households, locations, suppliers), runs a day-by-day loop over the specified horizon, processes interactions, updates states, and computes/outputs the required metrics.

issues.description: Required metrics and validation criteria are not implemented or tracked.
issues.location: Simulation class (no metrics storage or validation routines)
issues.solution: Track adoption_rate_over_time, peak_adoption_rate, time_to_majority_adoption, sustained_adoption_rate_last_14_days, noncompliance_rate_under_mandate, inequality_index_by_income, mask_shortage_days, and campaign_effect_size. Implement validation checks: convergence_stability, s_curve_fit (logistic fit with R^2), no_negative_inventory, and optional majority_by_target_day.

issues.description: Entity definitions and attribute names diverge from the specification (e.g., PolicyAuthority vs HealthAuthority; MediaSource vs InformationSource; mask_inventory vs masks_inventory; social_network_neighbors vs network_neighbors).
issues.location: Person, Household, Location, HealthAuthority, InformationSource, Retailer classes
issues.solution: Align class names and attributes to the spec or provide a clear mapping. For Person, include fields like age_group, demographic_group, compliance_propensity, social_influence_susceptibility, mask_inventory, last_wore_mask_day. For Location, include baseline_mask_requirement and observed_mask_rate. For PolicyAuthority and Supplier/MediaSource, match spec names and attributes.

issues.description: Core interactions are not wired into a simulation flow: social_influence, policy_mandate_effect, enforcement_interaction, supply_purchase, information_campaign, and norm_observation are not executed.
issues.solution: Implement daily steps: people decide_mask_wear; observe peers and locations; authority issues/lifts mandate and enforces; suppliers sell/restock; households allocate masks; media/authority broadcast messages; update risk perception/attitudes/habits; update location observed_mask_rate.

issues.description: Authority mandate updates do not propagate to locations after initialization, so location.mask_policy will not reflect mandate changes over time.
issues.solution: When mandate_on changes, update each non-home Location.mask_policy accordingly within the daily loop or via a dedicated method.

issues.description: Supply chain and purchasing are not implemented. Retailers exist, but persons never purchase masks; households do not allocate based on supplier purchases; stockout tracking is unused.
issues.location: Retailer class; Simulation (missing purchasing logic and stockout accounting)
issues.solution: Implement a purchase routine where persons or households acquire masks from retailers subject to stock, price, rationing, and price sensitivity. Increment stockout days when any retailer hits zero stock on a day. Add restock scheduling per restock_interval_days and restock quantities.

issues.description: Small-world network generator constructs a full candidate list for rewiring for each edge, which is O(n) per rewired edge and can be expensive for large n.
issues.solution: Use rejection sampling to select a new neighbor not equal to i and not in nbrs[i], or maintain a global set for efficient sampling. Alternatively, leverage a more efficient algorithm that avoids building candidate lists.

issues.description: Media reach and broadcast frequency are not used; information campaigns do not model differential exposure.
issues.solution: Apply media deltas probabilistically based on reach and schedule by broadcast_frequency. Incorporate message_bias and campaign intensity consistent with spec.

issues.description: Location lacks observed_mask_rate field and does not update it based on visitors, hindering norm_observation.
issues.solution: Add observed_mask_rate attribute and update it daily based on the fraction of visitors wearing masks to support norm observation.

issues.description: Stockout tracking variable is defined but never updated.
issues.solution: During daily purchasing, if any retailer inventory_level is zero at start or end of day, increment stockout_days.

issues.description: Several imports are unused (sys, json, csv, argparse, numpy, matplotlib).
issues.solution: Remove unused imports or use them if planning CLI, I/O, or plotting in main().

issues.description: Person attribute names slightly diverge from spec (masks_inventory vs mask_inventory; social_network_neighbors vs network_neighbors).
issues.solution: Rename fields to match spec or add properties/adapters to map names consistently.
